description: 3D city model of the TU Delft campus (TUDelft_campus_2007_CityGML_LOD1) is a model or code deposit deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors H. (Hugo) Ledoux, B.M.(Martijn) Meijers. One of the simplest methods to construct a 3D city model is to extrude building footprints to obtain “block-shaped" polyhedra representing buildings. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2011. Formats: XML. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is 4TU General Terms of Use. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
